message: Missing auth: this stack has user accounts but nothing authenticates them.
Missing database: you are self-hosting an API but nothing persists data.
Missing database: payments need somewhere to record orders and webhook events.
No test runner in this stack.
Deployed with no error tracking. You will hear about bugs from users first.
Containers with no CI, so images get built by hand.
Kubernetes with no infra-as-code, so cluster state will drift.
LLM keys need a server-side function or API to live in. Never ship them to the browser.
RAG without a vector store. Retrieval will not scale past a few documents.
Nothing builds this JavaScript. That is not a backend: pick Node, Bun or Deno to build locally, or a host like Vercel or Netlify that builds it for you.
Raw SQL with no query layer. Fine, but migrations are now your problem.
Browsers query these tables directly. Without row-level security policies, anyone holding the public key can read and write every row.
UI components with no styling system.
